爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD011 早川纱绫Hayakawa Saaya-不敢呼吸的距离
两人靠得太近，她蓝眼睛里全是慌乱的水光，连呼吸都小心翼翼。
浅蓝色裙子随着呼吸轻轻起伏。
他只是用指尖点了点她发烫的脸颊，笑着说：“别紧张。”她终于敢抬眼看他，眼里全是温柔。
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD011 Hayakawa Saaya-A Distance Where She Dared Not Breathe
They were too close, her blue eyes were filled with flustered tears, and even her breathing was cautious.
Her light blue dress rose and fell gently with her breath.
He simply touched her burning cheek with his fingertip and said with a smile, "Don't be nervous." She finally dared to look up at him, her eyes full of tenderness.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
